Messages.Author: floppyzedolfin
Messages.Body:
Hi,

- Suppose a vampire plays sup' Nocturn, sup' Nocturn and untaps.
The second sup' Nocturn cost him 1 (base cost) +1 (increased cost from
1rst Nocturn).

Now, he wants to play a third Nocturn. Is this Nocturn's cost 1 (base
cost) +1 (increased cost from 1rst Nocturn) +1 (increased cost from
2nd Nocturn), or is it just 1 (base cost) +1 (increased cost from
redundant 1rst and 2nd Nocturns) ?

- Suppose he plays sup' Nocturn, inf' Nocturn and untaps.
Can he play a third Nocturn?

Thanks,
Pascal


~~

Nocturn
Cardtype: 	Ally
Cost: 	1 blood
Discipline: 	Obtenebration
Demon with 1 life. 1 strength, 1 bleed.
[obt] Move Nocturn to the ready region when recruited. If this is this
vampire's first successful recruit action this turn, he or she untaps.
Nocturn can play non-ally cards that require basic Obtenebration as a
vampire. Burn Nocturn during your untap phase.
[OBT] As above, and this vampire may perform this action again this
turn, with the cost increased by 1 blood.

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
floppyzedolfin <floppyzedolfin@gmail.com> wrote:
> Hi,

> - Suppose a vampire plays sup' Nocturn, sup' Nocturn and untaps.
> The second sup' Nocturn cost him 1 (base cost) +1 (increased cost from
> 1rst Nocturn).

> Now, he wants to play a third Nocturn. Is this Nocturn's cost 1 (base
> cost) +1 (increased cost from 1rst Nocturn) +1 (increased cost from
> 2nd Nocturn), or is it just 1 (base cost) +1 (increased cost from
> redundant 1rst and 2nd Nocturns) ?

VTES English, and actually regular English, here.
The word "additional" stacks by default.
So the 1st Nocturn costs 1. The second Nocturn costs 2.
The third Nocturn costs 3. The fourth Nocturn costs 4.
The n'th Nocturn costs n blood.

> - Suppose he plays sup' Nocturn, inf' Nocturn and untaps.
> Can he play a third Nocturn?

No. Card text only provides the repeat-action at superior.
